name: oci-administrator
description: Tenancy-agnostic Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration for Codex and ChatGPT: safety-first skills for IAM, security, observability, databases, networking, cost, Log Analytics, Resource Manager, Data Safe, serverless, and project lifecycle work.

interface.shortDescription: Administer OCI safely across ten control-plane domains plus project lifecycle work.
interface.longDescription: OCI Administrator is a Codex and ChatGPT-ready skill pack for tenancy-agnostic Oracle Cloud Infrastructure administration. It routes requests across IAM, security, observability/database, Autonomous Database, networking/compute, cost, Log Analytics, Resource Manager, Data Safe, Events/Functions, and whole-project workflows. Users work by friendly named context instead of raw OCIDs; every mutation is preflighted, redacted, and confirmation-gated through the shared scripts.
defaultPrompt: Preflight my OCI dev compartment safely.
Audit OCI IAM posture without printing OCIDs.
Investigate OCI cost for the last 30 days.
